description.value:
An S-rank Mangekyō Sharingan illusion. Through a single moment of eye contact, the target perceives 72 hours of agony in less than a second of real time.

The target attempts a Will save with a -4 status penalty.

Critical Success The target is off-guard until the end of their next turn (the attempt still rattles them).

Success The target is stunned 2 as their mind reels.

Failure The target is unconscious for 1 minute and takes 8d6 mental damage. They can be roused early by an ally Treating Wounds with a successful DC 25 Medicine check.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also reduced to 1 Hit Point if their current HP is above that, and the duration is 24 hours instead of 1 minute. Recovery requires medical-nin attention or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.class-actions.Item.ClAcGenjutsuRels]{Genjutsu Release} cast at a counteract rank of 9 or higher.

Casting Tsukuyomi blinds you in the eye that cast it for 1 day and deals you 4d6 mental damage from the strain.

system.requirements: Mangekyō Sharingan active; target can see your eyes
